title: Hivo
oneLiner: Full-stack rental marketplace app launched on iOS App Store in Saudi Arabia

problem.heading: Problem
problem.description: International booking platforms offered generic experiences, while local hosts had no dedicated space to showcase authentic Saudi stays. Travelers wanted more than just a bed — they sought cultural immersion, from desert villas in AlUla to smart apartments in Riyadh. Existing solutions didn't offer bilingual support (Arabic/English), secure local payments, or curated stays that reflect the Kingdom's unique regions. Hosts needed a simple way to list their properties and manage bookings with confidence.

myRole.heading: My role
myRole.description: At Eignspaces (remote), I exercised full ownership over high‑impact full‑stack features for Hivo, including the unit management system and core user interfaces of the rental marketplace. I collaborated closely with project managers and designers to execute pixel‑perfect UI implementations, ensuring a high‑end aesthetic across the app. I also mentored interns on React Native and Expo, establishing best practices for cross‑platform mobile development, and pioneered AI‑driven development workflows to accelerate feature delivery.

solution.heading: Solution
solution.description: Built Hivo as a React Native + Expo mobile app with a Node.js/PostgreSQL backend. Implemented geo‑based search for destinations (AlUla, Riyadh, Jeddah), curated stay categories, and bilingual Arabic/English UI. Added secure payment integration, instant confirmation, dedicated support, and a host dashboard for property management. Used Redis for session caching and real‑time messaging between guests and hosts.

impact.heading: Impact
metrics: 📱 Published on iOS App Store (KSA region)
🤝 Active landlord signups and repeat guest bookings
impact.description: Hivo became a trusted alternative to international platforms, praised for authentic Saudi hospitality and seamless booking. The app continues to grow with ongoing feature enhancements.
